input_cost_comparison.ara_inputs: Monthly sunspot number only in this local stack.
input_cost_comparison.standard_method: NOAA/SWPC solar-cycle progression: statistical/cycle-curve product plus expert/panel forecasting, not a deep ML model.
input_cost_comparison.standard_inputs: Sunspot number, F10.7, solar-cycle progression, expert/panel curve forecasts and uncertainty bands.
input_cost_comparison.standard_input_count: 2 core public indices plus historical cycle archive, cycle-fit machinery, uncertainty bands, and panel/expert maintenance.
input_cost_comparison.standard_compute: Low direct compute; moderate operational burden because the product is maintained, validated, and expert-reviewed.
input_cost_comparison.standard_cost: Public data/products are free to consume; producing the official product is an institutional/moderate staff burden rather than a large HPC burden.
input_cost_comparison.comparison_status: Local proxy only. SWPC/panel archive benchmark still pending.

input_cost_comparison.ara_inputs: NINO3.4 alone, or NINO3.4 + SOI + east/west WWV feeder series.
input_cost_comparison.ara_input_count: 1 index for self-run, 4 observed indices for feeder-run.
input_cost_comparison.standard_method: IRI/CPC plume and NMME/CFSv2-style seasonal forecasting: coupled dynamical ensembles plus statistical models; some ML exists but is not the core operational baseline.
input_cost_comparison.standard_inputs: SST fields, subsurface ocean heat, winds, pressure, coupled ocean-atmosphere initial states, ensemble dynamical/statistical models.
input_cost_comparison.standard_input_count: Hundreds to millions of gridded state variables depending on model: ocean/atmosphere/land fields, multiple ensemble members, and many variables at daily/6-hourly/monthly cadence.
input_cost_comparison.standard_compute: High. Coupled climate ensembles and data assimilation require institutional HPC; statistical plume members are cheaper.
input_cost_comparison.standard_cost: Public forecast products are free to view; producing NMME/CFSv2-class forecasts is high-cost institutional modelling/HPC.
input_cost_comparison.comparison_status: Local proxy only. IRI/NMME/CFSv2 hindcast archive comparison still pending.

input_cost_comparison.ara_inputs: Monthly QBO 30mb wind index only in the self-forecast stack.
input_cost_comparison.standard_method: Seasonal/dynamical atmospheric models plus oscillator/statistical baselines; not usually a single public ML leaderboard.
input_cost_comparison.standard_inputs: Vertical wind profiles, stratospheric state, tropical wave forcing, seasonal/dynamical forecast models, level-specific hindcast scoring.
input_cost_comparison.standard_input_count: Many pressure levels and global atmospheric state fields if using seasonal models; 1 index if using a simple oscillator baseline.
input_cost_comparison.standard_compute: Low for oscillator/statistical baselines; moderate-high for seasonal Earth-system models.
input_cost_comparison.standard_cost: Public index data are free; operational dynamical model production is institutional/moderate-high.
input_cost_comparison.comparison_status: Local proxy only. Published/operational QBO hindcast comparison still pending.

input_cost_comparison.standard_method: Sea Ice Outlook style ensemble of dynamical, statistical, heuristic, and some ML methods.
input_cost_comparison.standard_inputs: Satellite extent/concentration, ocean/ice state, weather/climate forcing, statistical and dynamical ensemble submissions.
input_cost_comparison.standard_input_count: 1 index for simple statistical methods; gridded satellite concentration/extent plus ocean-atmosphere-ice fields for dynamical/ML systems.
input_cost_comparison.standard_compute: Low for extent trend/statistical models; moderate-high for coupled sea-ice/ocean/atmosphere models; ML training can be moderate-high but inference cheap.
input_cost_comparison.standard_cost: Public data are free; operational/dynamical modelling cost is moderate-high and multi-team.
input_cost_comparison.comparison_status: Local proxy only. Sea Ice Outlook September-submission comparison still pending.

input_cost_comparison.standard_method: CDC FluSight forecast-hub ensemble of many submitted statistical, mechanistic, ensemble, and ML models.
input_cost_comparison.standard_inputs: FluSight-style targets, hospital/ED/ILI surveillance, jurisdictional data, probabilistic quantiles/intervals, ensemble evaluation.
input_cost_comparison.standard_input_count: At minimum weekly target by jurisdiction; many teams add ED, hospitalization, lab, mobility, weather, demographics, or mechanistic state variables.
input_cost_comparison.standard_compute: Low for ARIMA/trend models; moderate for mechanistic and ensemble systems; some submitted ML/deep models have higher training cost.
input_cost_comparison.standard_cost: Public surveillance data are free; production model cost is moderate, with forecast-hub maintenance and WIS/relative-WIS scoring.
input_cost_comparison.comparison_status: Local proxy only. FluSight forecast-hub WIS/relative-WIS benchmark still pending.

input_cost_comparison.ara_inputs: FRED RSXFSN not-seasonally-adjusted retail sales transformed into a causal trailing-12-month cycle index.
input_cost_comparison.ara_input_count: 1 monthly retail series after local cycle transform.
input_cost_comparison.standard_method: X-13ARIMA-SEATS / ARIMA / ETS style statistical seasonal adjustment and demand forecasting; business systems often add ML/covariates.
input_cost_comparison.standard_inputs: Retail sales plus seasonal adjustment, revisions, ARIMA/ETS/X-13, often promotions, prices, inventory and macro covariates.
input_cost_comparison.standard_input_count: 1 official series for X-13-style adjustment; tens to thousands of product/location/promo/covariate fields in business demand forecasting.
input_cost_comparison.standard_compute: Low for official X-13/ARIMA on one series; moderate-high for SKU/store-scale ML demand systems.
input_cost_comparison.standard_cost: Public macro data are free; business-grade demand forecasts can be moderate-high depending on covariate systems.
input_cost_comparison.comparison_status: Local proxy only. Full X-13/ARIMA/ETS raw-sales comparison still pending.

input_cost_comparison.ara_inputs: CGM series only in the current self-forecast.
input_cost_comparison.ara_input_count: 1 glucose time series in the self-run.
input_cost_comparison.standard_method: Subject-specific physiological/statistical/ML glucose prediction; clinical products use validated medical workflows.
input_cost_comparison.standard_inputs: CGM plus meals/carbs, insulin, activity, sleep/stress context, subject-level splits, RMSE/MAE and event/clinical-grid metrics.
input_cost_comparison.standard_input_count: Often 4-8 core streams: CGM, insulin, carbs/meals, activity, sleep/stress/illness context, demographics, and device state.
input_cost_comparison.standard_compute: Low-moderate for per-subject statistical models; moderate for ML; high cost comes from clinical validation, safety, and regulatory process.
input_cost_comparison.standard_cost: Benchmark data may require agreements; clinical/pump-grade validation is high cost and regulatory/medical, not just compute.
input_cost_comparison.comparison_status: Not a clinical benchmark. OhioT1DM/D1namo/Tidepool-style driver benchmark pending.

input_cost_comparison.ara_inputs: ECG/RR and optional morphology features in prior local tests.
input_cost_comparison.ara_input_count: 1 ECG/RR stream in the simplest run; optional morphology features if enabled.
input_cost_comparison.standard_method: Signal-processing plus ML/deep-learning classification/forecasting on PhysioNet-style patient splits; clinical standard is validation-heavy.
input_cost_comparison.standard_inputs: PhysioNet-style patient splits, RR/morphology/arrhythmia targets, AR/ML/deep baselines, clinical event scoring.
input_cost_comparison.standard_input_count: 1-12 ECG leads sampled at high frequency, beat annotations, patient splits, labels, and often morphology/RR features.
input_cost_comparison.standard_compute: Low for classic signal processing and AR baselines; moderate for CNN/RNN/transformer training; inference is usually cheap.
input_cost_comparison.standard_cost: Public data are often free; clinical-grade validation is high cost because it needs patient-level task design and safety metrics.
input_cost_comparison.comparison_status: Research signal only. PhysioNet task benchmark pending.
